name: ask-credential-switching
description: Best effort, ask only. Asks a person before a shell command switches the identity later commands act as: aws --profile, AWS_PROFILE= or AWS keys (also $env:), sts assume-role, configure set of a key; gcloud account, configuration, login or impersonation; az account set, az login as a principal or identity; kubectl use-context or set-credentials; writes to ~/.aws, ~/.config/gcloud, ~/.azure. Names in .chock/credential-allowlist.json pass. Misses: scripts, SDKs, env files, credential_process. [Best-effort in Devin by a PreToolUse hook shipped with the plugin's hooks.json (witnessed blocking on Devin CLI 3000.11.3 (local session), Windows, 2026-10-08). In the vendor's own words, plugin hooks are 'currently best effort and fail open -- if a hook fails to load or run, the session continues without it -- so don't rely on them for crucial guardrails yet', documented for local Devin sessions (the CLI and Devin Desktop) only. The hook command expands $DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT, an environment variable the vendor documents hook commands receive; whether that expansion happens inside a hooks.json command string is documented, not witnessed here. The hook needs git and a Python 3.11+ on PATH. Repo-wide git-hook and CI coverage still needs `chock sync`.]
